blocks.text: Data, data science ki bunyad hai: kache haqaiq aur qeematon ka majmua jis se maloomat banti hain. Yeh numbers, text, tasaveer, audio ya video ho sakta hai, aur rozana bohat se kaamon se paida hota hai. Tajzie se pehle data samajhna zaroori hai, kyunke mukhtalif qismon ko mukhtalif tareeqe se sambhala jata hai; data ka durust aur qabil-e-aitbaar hona bhi zaroori hai, kyunke kharab data ghalat nataij deta hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Data ka miyar aakhri nataij par gehra asar dalta hai; kharab data ghalat nataij tak le ja sakta hai.

blocks.long_description: Jadeed systems dono use karte hain: hospital mareezon ke record tables mein (structured) aur X-ray tasaveer aur doctors ke notes (unstructured) rakhta hai.

blocks.text: Data ke zaraye aur jama karna

Data bohat se zaraye se jama ho sakta hai, jaise surveys, interviews, forms aur online platforms (blogs, social websites waghaira). Haath se jama karne mein insani mehnat lagti hai; khud-kaar jama karne mein machines aur software, maslan sensors, use hote hain. Tajzie ke maqsad ke mutabiq data foran (real time) ya waqt ke saath jama kiya ja sakta hai. Achhe zaraye aur durust jama karna tajzie ka miyar behtar karte hain.

Data storage ka matlab data ko aage istemal ke liye files, databases ya cloud mein mehfooz karna hai; theek storage use zaya hone se bachati hai. Data management ka matlab data ko munazzam aur barqarar rakhna hai taake dhoondna aur use karna asan ho. Security intizam ka ahem hissa hai, aur backup systems data zaya hone se rokte hain. Achhi tarah sambhala data kaar-amad aur taveel istemal ke qabil hota hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Tajzie se pehle data ki qism achhi tarah samajhna bohat zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Har aik ko structured ya unstructured batayein: class ka hazri register, record shuda lecture, fees ki spreadsheet, WhatsApp voice messages.
blocks.explanation: Structured: hazri register aur fees spreadsheet (muqarrar rows aur columns). Unstructured: record shuda lecture (video ya audio) aur voice messages (audio).

items: Data: kache haqaiq (numbers, text, tasaveer, audio, video); miyar ahem.
Structured: rows aur columns; unstructured: koi muqarrar shakal nahi.
Jama: surveys, interviews, forms, online, sensors; storage: files, databases, cloud, security aur backup ke saath.
